operating_notes.text: Received government permission to manufacture and sell DAP under the NBS scheme at the existing Udyogmandal, Kochi facility.
Commenced commercial production of Di-Ammonium Phosphate (DAP) at Udyogamandal plant effective 15th May 2026.
Discontinued consolidation of FACT - RCF Building Products Limited (FRBL) from FY2025-26 following NCLT order approving a Resolution Plan, though an appeal has been filed before NCLAT.
